<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Windfall tax reduction:</strong> The government has reduced windfall taxes on the export of petrol, diesel, and aviation turbine fuel, a move likely to improve margins for domestic oil refiners.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>STP export performance:</strong> India recorded Rs 7.73 lakh crore in exports under the Software Technology Parks (STP) scheme for fiscal 2026, highlighting the continued strength of the technology services export sector.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
